row.notes: mov rax,[rbp-8] in Sess_MarshalLights_AssignToZones (+0x197), 4 bytes, then mov r13,rbp; add r13,-8; vmovss [rax+0x34],xmm7 (+0x1a2); cmp r13,[rsi+0x68]; je +0x4a8. The step of the back-to-front walk over the light list (rsi = MarshalLightsSystem, list begin [rsi+0x68], end [rsi+0x70]): reached by jmp from +0x4a3 after a light got a zone (rbp = r13, one past it) and by fall-through after a light in no zone was erased (memmove at +0x18d, end -= 8 at +0x192, rbp = the erased light's slot). It loads the light before rbp and stores the walk's lap fraction (xmm7) at its +0x34. When the erased light was the first one, rbp == [rsi+0x68] and [rbp-8] is the 8 bytes before the list's block: 0 in all three crash reports (ACCESS_VIOLATION writing 0x34 at +0x1a2, F1_25.exe+0x2c794d2 on Steam 26566308, rbp = list begin, 7 lights left, capacity 42); a non-zero value would be written to and the walk would go on below the list (r13 = begin-8 never equals begin). No branch lands in +0x198..+0x19d.

verify.notes: gh:marshal-lights-blind Own capstone disasm of the whole function on the KB exe (.pdata 0x142c76da0-0x142c772c9, .xtls). 0x142c76f37 = +0x197 mov rax,[rbp-8] (4 bytes), then mov r13,rbp (+0x19b, 3 bytes; the 7 expect bytes are exactly these two instructions, neither rip-relative), add r13,-8, vmovss [rax+0x34],xmm7 at +0x1a2, cmp r13,[rsi+0x68], je +0x4a8. rsi = rcx at entry and never written again; both callers (0x142c7745d in .xtls, 0x14e5d4013 in .data1) pass the same object (light list at +0x68/+0x70). Paths in: fall-through after the erase (lea rbp,[r13-8] at +0x390; je to +0x180 from +0x3a5 empty zone list and +0x3d2 no zone matched; Ne_Crt_Memcpy(rbp, r13, end-r13) at +0x18d, overlap-safe; [rsi+0x70] -= 8 at +0x192) with rbp = the erased slot, and jmp from +0x4a3 after mov rbp,r13 at +0x4a0 (zone found) with rbp one past the light. All 57 branches in the function are direct and land on instruction boundaries, none in +0x198..+0x19d; no rel32 (every executable section), abs64 or rva32 reference to 0x142c76f38..0x142c76f3d in the image (disp32 hits at 0x142c76ead/0x142c76eb9 are [rsi+0x88]/[rsi+0x80] operands). r13 = begin-8 never equals begin. rsp is constant between prologue and epilogue. Pattern unique in KB .xtls (sigcheck OK) and whole-file unique on Steam 26566308 (.tls$ 0x2c794c2), EA 1.0.145 dump (0x2c6d212) and EA 1.0.141 dump (0x2c6ac82), equal to the overlay hints; the function body (318 instructions, same 57 branch offsets) is identical in all four.
